subject: general
question:
Identify the following constitutional attributes with their respective democratic values:

 
 

 
 
**Column A**

 
 
 
**Column B**

 
 
 

 
 
a.

 
 Fundamental Duties
 
 
i.

 
 Grassroots democracy
 
 

 
 
b.

 
 Equal voting rights
 
 
ii.

 
 Respect for individual conscience
 
 

 
 
c.

 
 Local self-government provisions responsibilities
 
 
iii.

 
 Recognition of citizens'
 
 

 
 
d.

 
 Religious freedom assurance
 
 
iv.

 
 Principle of universal franchise

options.text: a - ii, b - i, c - iv, d - iii
a - i, b - ii, c - iii, d - iv
a - iii, b - iv, c - i, d - ii
a - iv, b - iii, c - ii, d - i

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Fundamental Duties (a) are associated with the democratic value of **recognition of citizens' responsibilities**, ensuring that citizens contribute to the nation's development (iii).
 
• Equal voting rights (b) reflect the **principle of universal franchise**, ensuring equal political participation for all eligible citizens (iv).
 
• Local self-government provisions and responsibilities (c) promote **grassroots democracy**, empowering citizens at the village and town levels (i).
 
• Religious freedom assurance (d) aligns with the value of **respect for individual conscience**, emphasizing the right to freely practice and propagate religion (ii).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental Duties:**

 
 
• Introduced by the 42nd Amendment of the Constitution in 1976 under Article 51A.
 
• Encourage citizens to uphold values like patriotism, environmental protection, and respect for national symbols.
 
 
 
• **Universal Franchise:**
 
 
• Core democratic principle ensuring voting rights to all adult citizens irrespective of caste, creed, religion, or gender.
 
• India adopted universal adult suffrage as part of its Constitution in 1950.
 
 
 
• **Local Self-Government:**
 
 
• Empowers Panchayati Raj institutions and urban local bodies through the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments.
 
• Promotes participatory democracy and decentralized governance.
 
 
 
• **Religious Freedom:**
 
 
• Guaranteed under Articles 25-28 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Includes the freedom of conscience, free profession, practice, and propagation of religion.
